title: Pyramid Jumper
description: Jump through ancient Egypt, customize your character, and collect coins.

title: Elemental Fighters
description: Updated two-player fighting game with fixed keyboard controls.

title: City Speed Rally
description: Race through a colorful city skyline, dodge traffic and rocks, collect coins, and use boost.

title: Monkey Tree Swing
description: Choose from 14 monkeys, swing between jungle trees, collect coins and magic rings, and try not to fall!

title: Bike Rush: Road Sprint
description: Race across three lanes, dodge obstacles, collect coins, and unlock a five-second boost every 10 coins.

title: Super Cat Hero Dash
description: Dash through the city, switch lanes, jump over roadblocks, slide under barriers, and collect coins.

title: Robot Rescue
description: Rescue three robots in each factory level, dodge hazards, collect gears, and reach the exit.

title: WonderWorld
description: Updated bear adventure: explore the forest, collect crystals and rings, ride animals, build blocks and dig with the yellow digger.

title: Tesla GT Race 3D
description: Race a Tesla-style GT car against five rivals on a 3D road course with hills, bends, braking and steering.

title: Brick Builder
description: Build colorful creations, choose brick colors, and try the house and castle starter builds.

title: Dolphin Adventure
description: Swim through a bright ocean, collect shining pearls, and explore with simple touch controls.

title: Color Clash 3D
description: Join the blue team in a colorful 3D territory race, paint the arena floor, and capture towers against red and yellow computer teams.

title: New Game
description: Open and play the newly added game.
